user.title: Add Raylogic MOD2U / MOD4U / MOD2F
user.description: Device ka IP address daalo, aur Device Model chuno - MOD2U (2 channel, 1 pair), MOD4U (4 channel, 2 pairs), ya MOD2F (single-channel, fixed Fan type). Agla step aapke chune hue model ke hisaab se sirf utne hi channel fields dikhayega (MOD2F ke liye koi Type dropdown nahi dikhega - wo hamesha Fan hi hota hai, sirf Area aur channel number daalna hai).

channels.title: Configure channels
channels.description: Area wahi daalo jo Mod Settings screen mein dikhta hai (e.g. 12 ya 16). Area = 0 sirf tab chalega jab sabhi channel 'relay' hon (HA khud seekh lega app/switch se ek baar toggle karke) - Dimmer/Fan/Curtain/CTC ke liye Area zaroor manually dena hoga. Channels 2 PAIRS mein hote hain: Pair 1 = Channel 1(+2), Pair 2 = Channel 3(+4) (MOD2U par sirf Pair 1 exist karta hai). CTC (colour-temperature light) aur Curtain DONO apni pair ke dono physical channels internally use karte hain - agar Channel 1 Type = 'ctc' ya 'curtain' chuno to Channel 2 Type field automatically ignore ho jaata hai (ek hi entity banti hai), aur waisa hi Channel 3/4 ke liye. CTC choose karne par uska Driver Mode bhi batao - 'single' (app mein 'Single Driver' checked) ya 'double'.

data.channel_start: First Channel Number (usually 1, but check Raylogic GO app if channels don't start at 1)
data.channel_1_ctc_mode: Channel 1 CTC Driver Mode (only if Channel 1 Type = ctc)
data.channel_2_ctc_mode: Channel 2 CTC Driver Mode (only if Channel 2 Type = ctc)
data.channel_3_ctc_mode: Channel 3 CTC Driver Mode (only if Channel 3 Type = ctc)
data.channel_4_ctc_mode: Channel 4 CTC Driver Mode (only if Channel 4 Type = ctc)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to device. Check IP address and ensure device is powered on.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check logs for details.
error.area_required_for_non_relay: Dimmer/Fan/Curtain/CTC channels ke liye Area (0 nahi) manually dena zaroori hai - auto-learn sirf Relay ke liye kaam karta hai.

abort.already_configured: This Raylogic device is already configured.

init.title: Configure Raylogic device
init.description: Channel type (relay/dimmer/fan/curtain/ctc), Area, ya channel numbering yahan se badlo - device delete karne ki zaroorat nahi. Device Model yahan se badla nahi ja sakta - model change karna ho to device delete karke naya add karo. Yaad rakho: Pair 1 = Channel 1(+2), Pair 2 = Channel 3(+4) - Curtain/CTC ek pair ka dono channel consume karte hain.

error.area_required_for_non_relay: Dimmer/Fan/Curtain/CTC ke liye Area manually dena zaroori hai (0 sirf Relay LEARN mode ke liye chalta hai).

curtain_pair_unconfirmed.title: Pair {pair} curtain entity nahi bani
curtain_pair_unconfirmed.description:
Channel {channel} (Pair {pair}, device {ip}) ko Curtain configure kiya gaya hai, lekin uske open/close/stop command bytes abhi tak confirmed nahi hain. Isliye is pair ki entity HA me nahi banayi gayi.

**Fix:** Raylogic GO app se seedha is module (Pair {pair}) ke curtain ko ek baar Open, phir Close, phir Stop karo, aur us waqt app-aur-device ke beech ka network traffic (Wireshark/Docklight) capture karke *AR=/*AZ= wali exact line developer ko bhejo. Bytes milte hi entity turant ban jayegi, koi aur config change nahi karna padega.
